title: Cosmobox Level3 S7 campaign summary (v1)
description: The Level3 S7 campaign-level finalization marker: for each of the three geometries, the S6<->S7 primary taxonomy and continuous descriptors for M_TT/R_eff, the six-spin (S2,S3,S4,S5,S6,S7) directional sequence with REVERSAL_COUNT_234567, LAST_TWO_TRANSITIONS_DIRECTIONALLY_CONTINUOUS_567, and PAIRWISE_BLOCK_RECURRENCE_23_45_67, and a descriptive-only S2/S3/S4/S5/S6/S7 comparison for the control metrics. delta_hl_s2..s6/direction_s2..s6/t_x_56/c_x_56/d_x_56 are all read from the frozen Level3 S6 reference (which itself already embeds the S2/S3/S4/S5 values pinned from the frozen Level2, Level3 S4, and Level3 S5 references) -- none is ever recomputed. This document is written ONLY when the campaign is fully complete (3/3 S7 cases, 3/3 geometry comparisons, same repository_commit/manifest_fingerprint/campaign_id, all cases full-spectrum with zero partial subspaces, all four frozen references verified): its mere existence on disk is the completeness marker.

campaign_status.description: Always COMPLETE: an incomplete or failed campaign never produces this document at all.

level2_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level2 campaign supplied the S=2/S=3 reference data.

level3_s4_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level3 S4 campaign supplied the S=4 reference data.

level3_s5_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level3 S5 campaign supplied the S=5 reference data.

level3_s6_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level3 S6 campaign supplied the S=6 reference data.

geometries.description: Exactly triangle, ring4, ring5 -- no more, no fewer.

available.description: value is None if and only if reason is set.

reversalCount.description: REVERSAL_COUNT_234567: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 when all six directions (S2,S3,S4,S5,S6,S7) are resolved, else the literal string NOT_EVALUABLE. Descriptive only -- never a convergence criterion.

lastTwoTransitionsDirectionallyContinuou.description: YES iff sign(S5)=sign(S6)=sign(S7); NO iff the three signs are resolved and at least one of S5->S6 or S6->S7 changes sign; NOT_EVALUABLE iff any of the three signs is not resolved. Purely descriptive -- never a convergence criterion (docs/levels/level3/s7-fourth-extension-preregistration.md section 12).

pairwiseBlockRecurrence234567.description: YES iff all six directions (S2..S7) are resolved and sign(S2)=sign(S3), sign(S4)=sign(S5), sign(S6)=sign(S7), sign(S2)!=sign(S4), sign(S2)=sign(S6) -- i.e. the pattern A,A|B,B|A,A. NO iff all six are resolved but at least one of those (in)equalities fails. NOT_EVALUABLE iff at least one direction is not resolved. Purely descriptive -- never periodicity, parity, or convergence (docs/levels/level3/s7-fourth-extension-preregistration.md section 13).

delta_hl_s2.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S6 campaign-summary (itself pinned from the frozen Level2 campaign-summary) -- never recomputed.

delta_hl_s3.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S6 campaign-summary -- never recomputed.

delta_hl_s4.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S6 campaign-summary -- never recomputed from a re-executed S4 case.

delta_hl_s5.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S6 campaign-summary -- never recomputed from a re-executed S5 case.

delta_hl_s6.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S6 campaign-summary -- never recomputed from a re-executed S6 case.

t_x_56.description: abs(delta_hl_s6 - delta_hl_s5), pinned from the frozen Level3 S6 campaign-summary.

r_delta_x_67_56.description: t_x_67 / t_x_56, only when t_x_56 > 0. No threshold associated.

c_x_56.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S6 campaign-summary.

d_x_56.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S6 campaign-summary.

c_x_67.description: Computed with the same profiles.cross_profile_correlation primitive as C_X_56, on the S6<->S7 pair.

d_x_67.description: Computed with the same profiles.cross_profile_distance primitive as D_X_56, on the S6<->S7 pair.

r_d_x_67_56.description: d_x_67 / d_x_56, only when d_x_56 > 0. No threshold associated.

primaryS6S7Comparison.description: Mirrors the S6<->S7 primary comparison contract of docs/levels/level3/s7-fourth-extension-preregistration.md sections 10-14 exactly.

controlS6S7Comparison.description: Deliberately has NO primary_s6_s7_taxonomy/reversal_count_234567/last_two_transitions_directionally_continuous_567/pairwise_block_recurrence_23_45_67/shape-descriptor property -- additionalProperties:false makes it a schema error to include one (control channel never creates or overrides a primary result).
